ScenarioDef.label: The Ark
ScenarioDef.description:
The ship is the colony. Land. Take what you need. Don't stay too long. Leave. Do it again.

Playtest scenario for The Ark (V1.1). Starts a small expedition crew with Ark campaign state active. Use Dev Mode → The Ark (DEV) to set the M1 persistence fixture and prove save/load.

Requires Odyssey. Gravship wreckage start is not in this scenario yet.

scenario.name: The Ark
scenario.summary: Three crew, Ark campaign active, Dev tools for persistence proof. Surface playtest start (no gravship spawn yet).
scenario.description: Your expedition wakes on the surface with the Ark campaign already tracking you. Time will become pressure. For now: confirm the campaign state survives a save — then we teach the mod to feel landings and Pursuit.

li.text:
THE ARK — playtest start.

Campaign state is ACTIVE.

To prove M1 persistence:
1) Enable Dev Mode
2) Debug Actions → The Ark (DEV) → Apply M1 Persistence Fixture
3) Save → quit RimWorld completely → load
4) Confirm the LoadedGame log shows Day=47, Landing=6, Tier=2, Pursuit=73

Gravship landing/departure detection comes in later V1 milestones. This scenario is the New Game door into campaign tooling.
